grades_v0.reason: No ChIP-seq, allele-specific binding, MPRA, reporter, or footprint evidence is cited for CTCF binding at this variant. The only nearby support is a dELS 42 bp away with a weak maximum CTCF z-score of 1.5 across ENCODE biosamples, not allele-specific or HCT116-specific.
E03 directly supports that the nearest cCRE is EH38E2269392, 42 bp away, but not that this is a CTCF-bound element in HCT116 or that the variant alters it. No cCRE overlaps the variant itself.

E02 supports proximity of PYDC2 (19.5 kb upstream) and CCDC50 (112.6 kb downstream), and E03 lists these genes near the dELS. However, proximity alone does not establish that the variant regulates either gene, and no expression or perturbation evidence is cited.
The claim uses HCT 116 as the assay context, but the link has no evidence_ids and no cited HCT116 CTCF, ChIP, reporter, or expression data.
No evidence links allele-specific CTCF binding at this variant to PYDC2/CCDC50 regulation or to colorectal cancer. The phenotype statement is explicitly speculative and uncited.

No cited evidence shows NFKB1 binding at this variant or nearby element, let alone allele-specific binding of the alt G allele. NFKB1 is selected from a pyroptosis/inflammasome literature theme rather than QBiC-SELEX or direct occupancy data.

E01 supports that the variant is intronic in PYDC2-AS1 and E03 supports that it is 42 bp from a dELS. The claim that this is an inflammatory regulatory element affected by the variant is not supported; E03 gives only weak, biosample-max epigenomic marks and no cCRE overlap.
E02 supports PYDC2 as the nearest protein-coding gene at 19.5 kb, but no evidence shows that the variant or NFKB1 regulates PYDC2. The gene link is proximity-only.
The HCT 116 cell-context claim has no evidence_ids and no cited NFKB1, PYDC2, or inflammasome assay in HCT116.

The phenotype link to pyroptosis/inflammasome signaling and colorectal cancer is not demonstrated by the cited evidence. E06 literature hits do not provide direct support for PYDC2 regulation by NFKB1 at this variant.
